title: rudbeckia serotina var. sericea
intro: Rudbeckia serotina var. sericea, commonly known as Silver Glade Black-eyed Susan, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rudbeckia serotina var. sericea include its potential in reducing inflammation and pain due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
